               IN SUPPORT OF AN APPLICATION FOR A TYPE 1 MAP AMENDMENT
                             OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO ZONING MAP
           FOR THE PROPERTY COMMONLY KNOWN AS 2964-68 SOUTH ARCHER AVENUE


Applicant seeks a Type I Map Amendment of the City of Chicago Zoning Map from the currefit
Bl-1 District to that of a B2-3 District for the property commonly known as 2954-68 South
Archer Avenue. The site is composed of three legal lots. The total lot area of the subject site is
approximately 7,450 square feet. Applicant seeks to subdivide the property into three lots and
improve the currently vacant site with three, four story (one per lot) buildings. Each of the
buildings will provide ground floor commercial space and three residential dwelling units above
the ground floor. The property sits in the ARO Community Preservation Area and the ETOD
within 2,640 feet of the CTA rail station.

*The proposed developments will comply with section 17-3-0307 exceptions of the Chicago Air Quality

**The proposed developments will comply with section 17-3-0308 of the Equitable Transit-Oriented
Development Ordinance and must satisfy criteria 1-5 of that section.




17-3-0308 Specific Criteria for Transit-Served Locations. In B and C districts, any new
construction within 2,640 feet of a CTA or METRA rail station entrance must satisfy all of the
following specific criteria:

   1. The project complies with the applicable standards of Section 17-10-0102-8;

       No reduction in parking is sought. Therefore, the project complies with criterion #1.



   2. The project complies with the standards and regulations of Section 17-3-0504, except
      paragraph H if the project is not located along a pedestrian street, pertaining
      to pedestrian streets and pedestrian retail streets, even if the project is not located along
      a pedestrian street or a pedestrian retail street;

       The subject is not located in a located within the contemplation of the pedestrian street
       portion of the ordinance. Therefore, the project complies with criterion #2.

   3. The project complies with the general goals set forth in the Transit Friendly Development
      Guide: Station Area Typology, and any other station-specific plans, designs or guidelines
      adopted by the Chicago Plan Commission;

       The subject is served by the BS^'-Archer CTA station which is a Local Activity Center. LC
       anticipate higher density and employment uses, both of which are proposed by this project.
       Therefore, the project complies with criterion #3.
